profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Ciena
profile.summary:
I’m a Software Engineer with roughly 4 years of experience, focusing mostly on full-stack development. Technical stack includes Python, JavaScript/Typescript, and Angular. Experience in the DCOM space provided me knowledge in NETCONF, YANG, and MongoDB on a scale level. My experience in implementing new technologies and early project development demonstrate my ability to create solutions that best serve clients and their requirements.

Currently seeking opportunities, preferably hybrid/in-person to further my knowledge in application development! 

On the side, I cultivate my passion for woodworking. I currently have an apprenticeship under Garnero Guitars, with Arizona State University Professor Ed Garnero.

positions.title: Routing/IP Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Pivoted from a project that was full-stack web application development to a new, mostly back-end driven web application
• Assist in the creation of new web tool features through visual mockups and backend architectural planning
• Configure device pages to display various statistics and status information to customers
• Collaborate with various internal engineering teams to deliver more comprehensive and robust solutions to scale over 100,000 PON devices
• Integrate CRUD operations through the usage of MG-SOFT NETCONF, YANG models, XML, and Python
• Create unit tests in order to prevent possible regression bugs and maintain application stability 
• Utilize prompt-driven AI tools to increase application efficiency

positions.title: Routing/IP Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Collaborated on a small software development team to maintain and build a web application that focuses on building, customizing, and viewing PON networks on a commercial scale
• Translated verbal and ticketed customer requests to robust web solutions via Angular, HTML/CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, and Python
• Created over 20 frontend features enhancing user experiences
• Resolved over 120 backend and frontend bugs in order to amplify product efficiency and quality for customers 
• Constructed over 25 public and private API’s to necessitate streamline data passage for product features
• Managed various MongoDB data collections to effectively execute CRUD operations
• Assisted in new release documentation for customers to inform and demonstrate new product enhancements and development
• Showcased new features and improvements through live demonstration to present new quality of life user experience

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Developed various features for a globally utilized application that serves the purpose of durability testing for approximately 300 test engineers and drivers
• Refactored code with the aim of enhancing maintainability and decreasing complexity utilizing Sonar
• Enhanced frontend components with Angular, HTML, and Javascript to amplify user experience for customer base
• Increased automation test code coverage through the implementation of Jest, Junit, and test automation at minimum 70%
positions.insights: Skills: Jest · Test Automation · Angular · HTML · Git · SQL · JUnit · Spring Boot · Selenium · Java · JavaScript · TypeScript · Unit Testing · Scrum · Azure DevOps Server

positions.title: Community Development Officer
positions.description:
• Collaborated with executive board through meetings to organize future events for software-related content
• Created professional and social events for students interested in computer science related areas

positions.title: Fullstack Developer Intern
positions.description:
• Implemented Twitch API with Typescript in order to create premium commands for Kappamon, Adventure Studio's stream 
pet utilized by a vast community of over 300,000 live streamers
• Completed modular React components for Adventure Studio’s upcoming relaunched website
• Edited and created database associations through TypeORM for over 30 SQL entities in order to maintain code structure
• Produced over 20 unit tests for Typescript objects in a design tool for an upcoming game, Streamwalker Tribes
positions.insights: Skills: Jest · React.js · Git · JavaScript · TypeScript

positions.title: Central Operations Associate
positions.description:
• Learned to utilize seven different Amazon package assistance programs within a 4-day training period before hire
• Provided customer service to Amazon Driver Assistants and Dispatchers on the road for package assistance
• Responded quickly to Driver Assistants and Dispatchers within a 3-minute SLA

positions.title: Promoter and Exhibitor
positions.description:
• Networked with thousands of entrepreneurs, companies, and attendees about PiBo, Circulus’s AI robot
• Worked amongst professionals within Samsung C-Labs Inside and Outside
• Presented and marketed PiBo, a finalist for the title “Best of CES” presented by Engadget
